limitations: Stop if you cannot confirm a second-generation Nest Mini or match the Onju v2 board and assembly documentation.
Stop if you must retain Google Assistant, Cast, or stock multi-room behavior; those stock functions do not remain after the board swap.
Stop without a safe powered-off disassembly plan, access for the first flash before reassembly, or willingness to maintain an always-on ASR/LLM/TTS host.
onju-v2.evidence_reason: The README documents the second-generation Nest Mini replacement board, server setup and firmware flashing. Its X link points to an earlier Onju demonstration and is not evidence of testing the new v2 features.
onju-v2.recovery: Before starting, photograph cable and fastener positions and keep the original motherboard and hardware intact. If the replacement-board route is unsuitable and the original parts are undamaged, power off and reinstall the original board. There is no verified software recovery for physical damage.
